subject: LINAGE-COUNTER
notes: Format: LINAGE-COUNTER [ {IN|OF} file-name-1 ]. Grammar alternative `LINAGE_COUNTER ((OF | IN) cobolWord)?` is exactly the diagram (qualifier optional, exactly one of IN/OF). LinageFileOf treats the cobolWord as the file-name. Probes (probe/linage-counter/Q1, Q5, g4) at --std 85 and 2023: `LINAGE-COUNTER OF LPF`, `LINAGE-COUNTER IN LPG` and bare `LINAGE-COUNTER` all bind and read the right file's counter (Q1/Q5 print their OK line). The covering test writes both `OF LP1` and `IN LP2`. cite.py --check 8.4.3.14.3 "Qualification requirements for LINAGE-COUNTER are defined by 8.4.2.2, Qualification." -> OK. || editions as written by the adjudicator: 85 2002 2014 2023
